FOR INFORMATION: 


WILLI ERL, staff member of the Minau Institute in Bodensee, Germany 
and a member of the YMCA World Alliance's Standing Committee for Work with 
Refugees and Migrants will be in Montreal on Tuesday, December 15th. Mr. Erl 
will speak at a luncheon meeting at 12:30 p.m. in Room 253 of the Downtown 


YMCA, 141 Drummond St., 


Mr. Erl also will be available for personal interviews during the 


day. Please contact the undersigned for interview arrangements.
